heading: Saturday, July 19, 2025
topLine: OpenAI experimental model scores 35/42 on IMO 2025, graded by former medallists.

items.headline: OpenAI experimental model scores 35/42 on IMO 2025, graded by former medallists
items.summary: OpenAI researchers Alexander Wei and Noam Brown said an experimental general-purpose reasoning model solved five of the six IMO 2025 problems, for 35 of 42 points, which is gold-medal level. It worked under exam conditions with natural-language proofs and no tools. Three former IMO medallists graded the proofs; the result was not graded or certified by official IMO coordinators.
